name: Green Curry Chicken
description: Chicken thighs simmered in coconut green curry with spinach, bell pepper, and lime.
recipeIngredient: 2 cans coconut milk (13.5 oz full-fat, unshaken)

recipeInstructions.text: Cut chicken thighs into 1½-inch chunks and toss with salt. Open coconut milk and spoon off about ½ cup of the thick cream from the top of one can.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Brown the chicken in a single layer, turning once, 5-6 minutes; it needn't cook through. Move to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium. Cook yellow onion until soft, 4 minutes.
Add garlic, green curry paste, the reserved coconut cream, and jalapeño. Fry, stirring, until very fragrant and the oil separates, 2 minutes.

Stir in the rest of the coconut milk, chicken broth, fish sauce, and sugar. Return the chicken and its juices and simmer gently, uncovered, 10 minutes. Add red bell pepper and simmer until the chicken is cooked through and the pepper is crisp-tender, 5 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in baby spinach until wilted, then the juice of one of the limes. Taste and adjust with fish sauce, sugar, lime, or more paste.
Serve over the rice with cilantro and wedges of the other lime.
Paste heat varies: start with 3 tbsp of Maesri or Mae Ploy; mild Thai Kitchen may need the whole jar.
With only one can of coconut milk: fry the paste in oil instead of cream, use 2–3 tbsp paste and 1 cup broth, and stir in ¼ cup heavy cream at the end.
